answer: On this tree the useful no-oracle test is MR-REORDER-UNORDERED-CASES: permuting independent cases must leave case-id-keyed scores unchanged. CNF-0075 execute_case on fusion_union satisfies it at the pre-stated threshold 0 (source fingerprint equals follow-up; distance 0). A positional score tuple is a genuine defect and the checker fires on that known-broken fixture while staying silent on the known-good rebind. Prompt-paraphrase exact-match is excluded: a violation is acceptable generative variance, not a fault. Identifier renaming of primary keys is excluded for the same reason (different input, not a follow-up). SUCCESS:RES-0092 in the receipt AND one implemented relation with its run output and a pre-stated variance threshold

both_states.fixture_note: Attempt 1 used case order pass/fail/pass, whose positional tuple (1,0,1) is a palindrome: reverse left the broken fingerprint unchanged. That is fixture-unrepresentative, not an unbuildable detector. Attempt 2 uses pass/pass/fail (1,1,0) reversed to (0,1,1).

canonical_mechanism: Metamorphic testing (Chen, Cheung, Yiu 1998; surveyed by Segura, Fraser, Sanchez, Ruiz-Cortes, IEEE TSE 42(9):805-824, 2016, DOI 10.1109/TSE.2016.2532875): judge a pipeline by whether a follow-up input related to the source by a named transformation produces an output related by a named equivalence, without a ground-truth oracle for either output.

claims.claim: Reordering independent cases should leave case-id-keyed scores invariant; CNF-0075 execute_case on fusion_union satisfies that relation at threshold 0.
A positional score tuple is a genuine defect relative to the same relation: reverse permutation changes the tuple while case-id rebinding does not.
Prompt-paraphrase exact-match is a useful metamorphic relation for LLM pipelines.

excluded_relations.candidate: paraphrasing a prompt should leave output invariant
excluded_relations.justification: Exact-string invariance under prompt paraphrase is not a fault oracle for generative LLM steps: decode is stochastic and semantically equivalent wording is acceptable variance. Segura et al. 2016 require that a relation violation indicate a fault. Shipping exact-match-after-paraphrase as an MR would fire on healthy pipelines. A similarity MR would need a named metric and a threshold chosen before seeing distances; this tree has no live LLM decode step on which to freeze that number, so the relation is excluded rather than implemented with a fabricated threshold.

excluded_relations.candidate: renaming identifiers should leave output invariant
excluded_relations.justification: Alpha-renaming applies to bound variables whose names are not observable. Catalog unit ids and capability tokens are the payload: renaming them is a different source input, not a metamorphic follow-up. A violation would not be a defect. Stage-id renaming on CNF-0075 execute_case would be a valid MR (the step ignores stage id) but is not the implemented detector in this unit.

implemented_relation.expected_invariance: The mapping case_id -> score is identical. Distance is the count of case_id keys whose scores differ.
implemented_relation.name: reorder independent cases; rebound pass/fail must match
implemented_relation.transformation: Reverse the unordered collection of independent capability cases (source -> follow-up).
implemented_relation.why_violation_is_a_defect: Independent cases are not a sequence. A positional score vector that changes when the same cases are reordered is order dependence in the reporter, not acceptable variance.

negative_controls.description: Positional score tuple must violate MR-REORDER under reverse; case-id fingerprint must not; identity permutation silent on both.

question: Which metamorphic relations (reordering inputs, renaming identifiers, paraphrasing a prompt) should leave an agent pipeline's output invariant, and does the pipeline actually satisfy them - the test that needs no ground-truth oracle?

title: Extract metamorphic testing relations applicable to LLM-driven pipelines

variance_threshold.rationale: Deterministic capability pipeline (CNF-0075 execute_case) emits exact 0.0/1.0 scores. Independent cases form an unordered collection for pass/fail keyed by case id. Any mismatch after permutation is a genuine order-dependence defect, so the threshold is 0. Chosen from the pipeline's determinism, not from observed distances.
